correctness.rationale: The proof reduces color equality to rooted universal-cover truncation isomorphism using Krebs--Verbitsky Lemma 2.6. The tadpole universal cover is explicitly a periodic spine with pendant tails. Distinct cycle distance classes need at most floor(m/2) rounds, tail positions need exactly ceil(k/2) rounds internally, and the cycle-neighbor/tail-neighbor pair survives exactly min(m,k)-1 rounds before splitting. These give matching upper and lower bounds. Direct replay verifies 3840 parameter pairs and all fixed-order extrema through order 100.
